parent_objective: run one-seed fixed-budget L0/L1/L2/L3 profile training/eval smoke after corrected runtime smoke passes
blocked_by: M1385 passes runtime smoke and admits one-seed fixed-budget training/eval smoke
supersedes: jumping directly to a 3-seed profile pilot
claiming profile ranking before one-seed fixed-budget plumbing is verified

public_gates: M1386 may run exactly one fixed-budget seed per corrected profile
M1386 must use the same training seed and eval seed block for every profile
M1386 must record failed profiles instead of omitting them
M1386 must not promote, use private holdout, tune profiles, export corpus, or claim paper-level/profile-ranking evidence
forbidden_shortcuts: do not tune hyperparameters after seeing profile results
do not add hidden or oracle actor inputs
do not claim architecture ranking from one seed

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: runs one fixed-budget seed per corrected profile to verify train/eval plumbing before a public pilot
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: one-seed public training/eval smoke only; no promotion private-holdout paper-level generalization recurrent-belief or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if any profile fails and route to repair before 3-seed pilot
stop if fixed protocol changes after seeing a profile result
stop if corrected controls are bypassed during training or evaluation
fallback_plan: if one or more profiles fail, record failures and route to focused repair
if runtime is excessive, audit resource usage before scaling
if all profiles complete, route to result audit before 3-seed pilot
if metrics are non-finite, route to metric/eval repair

admission_evidence: M1385 runtime smoke provides pretrain capability evidence that all corrected profile configs instantiate before training
M1384 and M1385 provide exact public gate discipline by requiring fixed profile set, fixed seed/eval protocol, current-tiled controls, corrected reset-control, and no claim expansion
M1384 provides rollback and repair protection by routing any failed profile, non-finite metric, current-tiled failure, or reset-control failure to focused repair before a 3-seed pilot
blocked_shortcuts: do not make profile-ranking, paper-level, or self-ID claims
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, review, and next manifest
next_stage_criteria: all eight profile seed runs complete or failures are recorded
profile seed rows and aggregate rows are recorded
claim scope remains one-seed smoke only
next audit or repair milestone is selected

profile_smoke_protocol.eval_seed_policy: same 32 public eval seeds for every profile checkpoint

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1386 includes current-tiled L2 controls and corrected L3 reset-control but remains one-seed plumbing evidence only.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: One public training seed and 32 public eval seeds per profile.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If controls match or beat normal profiles, record it and route to audit; do not weaken claim standards.
allowed_claims: no recurrent-belief, strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, paper-result, or architecture-ranking claim

hypothesis: All eight corrected history-profile configs can complete one fixed-budget train/eval seed with finite metrics under the current codebase.
success_criteria: no promotion or actor-input contract change occurs
claims are limited to one-seed fixed-budget smoke
failure_criteria: profile-specific budgets or hyperparameters change after seeing results
metrics are framed as architecture-ranking or paper-level evidence
hidden or oracle actor inputs are introduced
failed profiles are omitted from summary
corrected controls are not applied in training or evaluation

commands.name: run_one_seed_smoke
commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m autodrift.corrected_profile_pilot --config-dir configs/paper_route_corrected_profiles --config-glob 'm1207_*.json' --run-dir runs/m1386_history_profile_fixed_budget_smoke --training-seed-base 138600 --seed-offsets 0 --eval-seed-base 138700 --eval-episodes 32 --device cpu

decision_rule: M1386 passes if all eight corrected profiles complete one fixed-budget train/eval seed with finite metrics and no claim expansion or protocol drift.
